meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 把代码评审意见压成单行:位置、问题、修复;用 🔴bug、🟡risk、🔵nit、❓q 标注类型;只输出可直接粘贴的评论,不写修复代码、不批准、不跑 linter。
howto.when: 当你说“review this PR”、“code review”等,或调用 /caveman-review 时;审查 pull request 时也会自动触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审一下这个 PR
say.note: 会得到单行、可直接粘贴的评审意见

say.text: 这个 diff 有哪些风险?用最短格式列出来
say.note: 会按严重程度加前缀标出
退出压缩评论,改用详细写法

howto.what_en: Claude turns PR feedback into one-line review comments: location, problem, fix. Adds severity prefixes (bug/risk/nit/question). Output is paste-ready only; it never writes the fix, approves, or runs linters.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'review this PR', 'code review', 'review the diff', '/review', or invokes /caveman-review; also auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

say_en.note: Get one-line review comments ready to paste.

say_en.text: List risks in this diff in the shortest format.
